title: Lake Trip
passage:
We are on a fun trip to a big lake, and we all feel glad to go.
The sun is up, and the air is warm as we pack up our bags.
Dad has a map, and Mom has a plan, and we all hop in the van.

We ride on a long road, and we see red barns and green trees.
A fox runs by, and we all look and laugh at the fast red fox!
The van hums on, and we sing a song as we go along.

At the lake, we jump out and run to the dock by the water.
The sand is soft, and the waves are slow and calm on the shore.
We toss a ball, and we skip rocks, and we splash in the cool lake.

You can sit in the sun, or run and play with a pal.
We all feel glad and free and full of fun at the lake.
As the day ends, we pack up slow and head back home again.

It was a good day, and we all cannot wait to go again!
